name: openworkgraph-local
description: Connect Claude Desktop to the local OpenWorkGraph workflow context layer.
long_description: Uses the OpenWorkGraph installation already running on this computer. Workflow evidence remains in the local OpenWorkGraph store until Claude requests it through MCP. AI access can be turned off instantly from the OpenWorkGraph dashboard.

tools.name: get_workflow_trace
tools.description: Read compact paginated chronological workflow evidence.

tools.name: get_current_work_context
tools.description: Read current rich workflow context and small task hints.

tools.name: find_similar_work
tools.description: Find prior work similar to a description.

tools.name: find_process_examples
tools.description: Find inferred executions of a task family.

tools.name: company_workflow_summary
tools.description: Read a compact workflow and effort summary.

tools.name: get_work_session
tools.description: Read one work session as a compact trace.

tools.name: automation_candidates
tools.description: Read repeated-work candidates for human-reviewed automation.
